text: Income from the Securities Lending Program is generated by fees paid by the Borrowers and income from investment of cash collateral, All cash collateral is pooled for investment purposes, In acting as Agent for the Participant, the Bank will receive 40% on the net earnings from each loan and the Participant will receive 60%, The fees will be calculated monthly and the Bank's fee will be ' withheld from the remittance to the Participant or the Account.
